summary: Callback plugins respond to events and drive most CLI output; subclass CallbackBase as CallbackModule and override v2_* methods listed in the callback __init__.py.
questions: How do I write a callback plugin?
Which callback methods should I override?

answer_card.title: Callback plugin basics
answer_card.answer_md:
```python
from ansible.plugins.callback import CallbackBase

class CallbackModule(CallbackBase):
    pass
```
Override only methods starting with `v2` (Ansible 2.0+). See `lib/ansible/plugins/callback/__init__.py` for the full list. Callbacks control most CLI output.
